uuid.description: Unique key for the linked user

id.description: Ivo Systems database ID for the user account

companyId.description: Ivo Systems company ID this user belongs to

companyRoleId.description: ID of the company role assigned to this user

employeeId.description: ID of the employee record linked to this user

divisionId.description: ID of the division this user is assigned to

vendorId.description: ID of the vendor linked to this user if applicable

isMechanic.description: Whether the user is a mechanic

isDriver.description: Whether the user is a driver

isActive.description: Whether the user account is active

isDeleted.description: Whether the user account has been soft deleted

createdTimestampUtc.description: UTC timestamp when the user account was created

updatedTimestampUtc.description: UTC timestamp when the user account was last updated

description: Ivo Systems linked user object - a platform user account linked to an employee
